description: This file defines the HTMLRewriter class, which uses htmlparser2 to parse and transform HTML content, allowing custom handling of HTML tags, comments, and text.

classes.name: HTMLRewriter
classes.description: A class for parsing and transforming HTML content with customizable tag handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the HTMLRewriter with optional tag handling callback.

methods.name: closeTag
methods.description: Closes the current HTML tag if open.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Processes an HTML string and returns the transformed HTML.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends HTML content to the transformed output.
